The '''''Justice''''' was a [[Ranger-class gunship|''Ranger''-class gunship]] used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During [[Second Battle of Bilbringi|Operation Trinity]], the ''Justice'' was part of a task force assigned to the [[Mon Mothma (Imperial-class)|''Mon Mothma'']].<ref name="TCSWE" />
